DIGEST_CONVENTION.name: LEDGER_RECORD_DIGEST_V1
DIGEST_CONVENTION.digest_payload: canonical JSON of the COMPLETE record EXCLUDING record_digest
DIGEST_CONVENTION.canonicalisation: UTF-8, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), no pretty-print dependence
DIGEST_CONVENTION.genesis: same convention, excluding its own record_digest
DIGEST_CONVENTION.why: a record cannot contain its own hash. Freezing this now avoids the self-reference ambiguity and the same failure class as MANIFEST_SEMANTIC_DIGEST vs FILE_BYTE_DIGEST.
verified: sealing an already-sealed record is refused
